question: How is the length of the foot specified and increased?
premises: The length of the foot is declared.
It increases by a quarter measure.
inference: The foot length starts at two finger-widths and increases by quarter increments.
uncertainties: Exact unit implied by pāda-vṛddhi depends on context.
plain_english: The length of the foot is declared to begin from two finger-widths and increase by quarter measures.
